source.close_reason: Resolved both review-gate blockers, rebased and pushed the fix, all required checks passed, merged PR #215, and fast-forwarded local specialists master.
source.description:
## PROBLEM
PR #215 cannot merge because the review gate reports two unresolved Codex threads: service-skills-sync still hard-codes legacy service-skills paths, and retained roadmap documents cite an archive file removed by the docs ignore cleanup.

## SUCCESS
Update the specialist prompt to prefer service-knowledge with legacy fallback for scope, migration, contract, and drift-sync paths; retain the cited archive source or update references so the PR remains internally navigable; push fixes and get PR #215 checks green.

## SCOPE
/home/dawid/dev/specialists/config/specialists/service-skills-sync.specialist.json; /home/dawid/dev/specialists/.gitignore; referenced roadmap documents and docs/archive/iron-review-hardening-qa-chain-substrate.md as needed; PR #215.

## NON_GOALS
- Do not merge unrelated runtime features.
- Do not remove user-facing examples, roadmap, or upgrade docs.
- Do not bypass or dismiss the review gate.

## CONSTRAINTS
Preserve the requested docs-ignore audit and all existing PR edits. Prefer service-knowledge first, service-skills fallback. Resolve the exact cited archive reference without broadening the ignored docs set.

## VALIDATION
- [ ] All hard-coded service path loops have service-knowledge-first fallback coverage.
- [ ] Retained roadmap references resolve to tracked files.
- [ ] PR checks pass, especially pr-review-gate.
- [ ] Worktree is clean and PR remains the intended scope.

## OUTPUT
Updated PR URL, commit SHAs, review findings resolved, and check evidence.
source.title: Resolve PR 215 review gate findings
